description: Verify the specified Power BI Workspace Collection name is valid and not already in use.

operations.description: Verify the specified Power BI Workspace Collection name is valid and not already in use.

params.description: Gets subscription credentials which uniquely identify a Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.
params.name: subscriptionId

props.description: Message indicating an unavailable name due to a conflict, or a description of the naming rules that are violated.
props.name: message

props.description: Specifies a Boolean value that indicates whether the specified Power BI Workspace Collection name is available to use.
props.name: nameAvailable

props.description: Reason why the workspace collection name cannot be used.
props.name: reason

responses.description: Default Response. It will be deserialized as per the Error definition specified in the schema. Exception will be thrown.
